facts.claim: Norwegian Sky (Norwegian Cruise Line): Entered service 1999; 77,104 GT; 2004 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 259 m length; Sun class.
Norwegian Sky is a Sun-class cruise ship owned and operated by Norwegian Cruise Line.

She was originally ordered by Costa Cruises as Costa Olympia from the Bremer Vulkan shipyard in Germany, but she was completed in 1999 by the Lloyd Werft shipyard in Bremerhaven, Germany for the Norwegian Cruise Line under the name Norwegian Sky.

catalogSpecs.description: Operated by Norwegian Cruise Line; entered service 1999; 110,000 GT; approx. 2,004 guests.
